subprocess_flow.substep_name: Submit Automated Intake and Validate Metadata
subprocess_flow.description: The AI Project Lead enters project charters, system specifications, and use case details into the automated self-service registration intake form. The system executes immediate syntactic and semantic validation against pre-approved metadata schemas and templates, rejecting non-conformant or missing data fields before workflow progression.
outputs: Automated Self-Service Intake Form with Pre-Validated Metadata
success_criteria: Automated intake form submitted without syntax or schema errors
Pre-validated metadata verification successfully completed with zero registration delay
Pre-Approved Metadata Validation Report generated and recorded
subprocess_flow.purpose: Capture standardized project attributes rapidly while preventing malformed or incomplete records from entering the governance pipeline.
subprocess_flow.scope: All AI/ML project submissions, COTS integrations, and Foundation Model intake requests across MoJ agencies.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Submission of a new AI/ML project proposal, COTS acquisition request, or major system modification
end_conditions: Intake metadata validated against schema and committed to intake repository

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Incomplete or inaccurate metadata entry bypassing initial automated checks
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated server-side JSON schema validation against centrally approved MoJ metadata standards

governance_requirements: CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) Tiering

change_management.change_request_process: Field or concept adjustments require resubmitting the self-service intake form

subprocess_flow.description: The automated governance triage engine parses responses from the self-service triage questionnaire and intake metadata against predetermined low-risk criteria. Eligible internal productivity or low-impact analytical use cases are routed immediately via the zero-touch pathway, generating automated receipts and expediting downstream approvals.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
inputs: Automated Self-Service Intake Form with Pre-Validated Metadata
dependencies: Submit Automated Intake and Validate Metadata
success_criteria: Automated zero-touch triage executed successfully for eligible low-risk projects
Intake tiering report generated with baseline risk score
Routing receipt dispatched to project lead and enterprise architecture
subprocess_flow.purpose: Eliminate initial intake bottlenecks by instantly triaging eligible low-risk applications without requiring manual queue inspection.
subprocess_flow.scope: Automated scoring of use cases to determine eligibility for fast-track or standard governance tracks.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Successful validation and publication of Pre-Approved Metadata Validation Manifest
end_conditions: Issuance of Automated Intake Tiering Report and Zero-Touch Routing Receipt

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Erroneous automated routing of high-impact judicial algorithmic tools into fast-track channels
step_risks_and_controls.control: Rule-based failsafe locks requiring mandatory manual override escalation for any system touching offender, court, or sentencing data

governance_requirements: CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) Tiering
Crown Commercial Service AI Procurement Guidance

change_management.change_request_process: Triage rule modifications submitted via Architecture Review Panel change tickets
change_management.versioning_rules: Triage rule definition engines tracked and versioned in Git

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Classify Data Assets and Security Tier
subprocess_flow.description: The Data Protection Officer and Information Asset Owner evaluate the candidate dataset descriptors and ingestion architecture against HMG Government Security Classifications. This evaluation identifies criminal justice, victim, and offender data, establishes OFFICIAL or OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE boundary requirements, and produces the certified Data Classification Assessment.
inputs: Automated Self-Service Intake Form with Pre-Validated Metadata
subprocess_flow.estimated_duration: 1-2 business days (under 4 hours for zero-touch fast-track)
success_criteria: HMG Security Classification approved by IAO
Special category and offender data identified and assigned isolation controls
Signed Data Classification Certificate committed to the governance record
subprocess_flow.purpose: Enforce strict information security tiering to guarantee sensitive justice datasets operate within compliant technical and operational perimeters.
subprocess_flow.scope: All structured and unstructured data feeds, APIs, and storage targets designated for AI models.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of Automated Intake Tiering Report
end_conditions: Formal sign-off of the Data Classification Certificate by the Information Asset Owner

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Misclassification of sensitive offender or court records as non-sensitive OFFICIAL data
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory IAO approval gate and automated data dictionary checks for sensitive justice taxonomy

governance_requirements: UK Data Protection Act 2018 Part 3 (Law Enforcement Processing)

change_management.change_request_process: Dataset schema modifications require submission to Data Governance and IAO re-approval
change_management.versioning_rules: Data Classification Assessment versioned as v0.2

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Determine Governance Pathway and Assess COTS/LLM Intake
subprocess_flow.description: The Enterprise Architect and AI Project Lead categorize the solution across statutory regulatory risk tiers and select the target evaluation pathway: bespoke development, commercial-off-the-shelf software (COTS), SaaS, or third-party Foundation Model / LLM. For closed-source foundation models and vendor products, the team reviews vendor model cards, API security boundaries, and SOC2/ISO 27001 audit certifications in lieu of unavailable internal weights.
outputs: NIST / EU AI Act Risk Tier Classification
COTS / Foundation Model Evaluation Pathway Determination
dependencies: Classify Data Assets and Security Tier
success_criteria: System mapped accurately against EU AI Act risk levels and NIST AI RMF profiles
Governance track confirmed (Bespoke vs COTS/LLM vs Fast-Track)
Vendor security and model documentation validated for closed-source systems
subprocess_flow.purpose: Establish statutory compliance obligations and calibrate evaluation tracks so commercial or generative AI tools avoid irrelevant bespoke data requirements.
subprocess_flow.scope: Regulatory scoping, risk tier assignment, and third-party supplier assurance across bespoke and commercial models.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
end_conditions: Formal recording of Risk Tier Classification Dossier and COTS/LLM pathway determination

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Unvetted ingestion of third-party Foundation Model services or COTS software with hidden data-retention vulnerabilities
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory vendor compliance screening verifying zero-day data retention, SOC2 Type II controls, and boundary API security

governance_requirements: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
Crown Commercial Service AI Procurement Guidance

change_management.change_request_process: Architecture or vendor changes require resubmitting the pathway determination dossier
change_management.versioning_rules: Risk Tier Classification Dossier versioned as v0.3

improvement_inputs: COTS and Foundation Model pathway adoption rate
UK AISI and international AI safety policy updates

subprocess_flow.description: The Data Protection Officer reviews personal data flows, processing logic, and potential algorithmic impact on data subjects under UK GDPR Article 35. The screening establishes whether automated profiling, high-risk scoring, or special category processing is occurring and outlines mandatory privacy controls.
inputs: NIST / EU AI Act Risk Tier Classification
COTS / Foundation Model Evaluation Pathway Determination
dependencies: Determine Governance Pathway and Assess COTS/LLM Intake
success_criteria: UK GDPR Article 35 screening checklist completed and approved by DPO
Privacy-enhancing technologies and legal bases documented
Mandatory DPIA actions integrated into project governance plan
subprocess_flow.purpose: Verify data protection compliance early and ensure automated processing complies with statutory UK privacy obligations.
subprocess_flow.scope: Personal and special-category data handling within the AI system.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Approval of Risk Tier Classification Dossier
end_conditions: Approval and sign-off of Preliminary DPIA by DPO

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Commencing model development or procurement without an established legal basis under UK GDPR / DPA 2018
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated pipeline gating prohibiting infrastructure or procurement provisioning without a certified Preliminary DPIA

governance_requirements: ICO AI and Data Protection Guidance

change_management.change_request_process: Changes in data subject scope or processing mechanisms require formal DPIA revision

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Authorize Inception Gate and Log Registry Record
subprocess_flow.description: MoJ Enterprise Architecture and the Information Asset Owner review the consolidated inception documentation pack, executing dual sign-off. The project is formally enrolled in the centralized MoJ AI Registry, assigned a persistent unique asset identifier, and routed to the corresponding downstream governance tracks.
inputs: COTS / Foundation Model Evaluation Pathway Determination
success_criteria: Use case registered in MoJ AI Registry with persistent unique ID
Dual sign-off completed by Enterprise Architecture and IAO
Initial risk tier and governance pathway agreed with automated intake completion
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide definitive architectural and asset owner authorization, recording immutable inception records before downstream expenditure or technical implementation.
subprocess_flow.scope: Enterprise registration, registry indexation, and governance routing across all MoJ AI use cases.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Submission of completed Preliminary DPIA and classification pack
end_conditions: Registered AI Use Case Record published in the MoJ Centralised AI Registry and baseline locked at v1.0

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Shadow AI development progressing without centralized registry tracking
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory cryptographic token generated by MoJ AI Registry required to unlock CI/CD compute and cloud data access

governance_requirements: CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) Tiering

change_management.change_request_process: Post-registration scope changes submitted to Enterprise Architecture via Jira/ServiceNow
change_management.versioning_rules: Final Inception Dossier locked and baselined as v1.0
